definition.definition: C++ (pronounced as "C plus plus") is a high-level general-purpose programming language as an extension of the C programming language, or "C with Classes".

inside_fragment.title:
Install a C++ Compiler:
Windows:
Download and install MinGW from the MinGW website.
During installation, select gcc (GNU Compiler Collection) and g++ packages.
Add the bin directory of MinGW to your system's PATH environment variable. The default path is usually C:\MinGW\bin.
MacOS:
Install Xcode Command Line Tools by running the following command in Terminal:
sh
Copy code
xcode-select --install


Linux:
Use your package manager to install g++. For example, on Debian-based systems, run:
sh
Copy code
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install build-essential

Verify C++ Compiler Installation:
Open Command Prompt (CMD) or Terminal.
Type g++ --version and press Enter. You should see the installed version of g++, confirming the installation was successful.
